messages:
eli: quick flag - saw confirmed token counts > provisional after a resume during a model variant swap (q8 -> fp). short logs below
eli: ```
2026-04-01T09:10:00Z router route=canary model=rw-v4-q8 session=aa1 resume=false
2026-04-01T09:10:02Z runtime provisional=20 prefix_hash=phx session=aa1 checksum=0x111
2026-04-01T09:10:03Z router fallback -> stable model=rw-v4 resume=true session=aa1
2026-04-01T09:10:04Z runtime confirmed=24 prefix_hash=phx session=aa1 checksum=0x222
2026-04-01T09:10:04Z ledger provisional +20 origin=stream session=aa1
2026-04-01T09:10:05Z ledger confirmed  +24 origin=toolcall session=aa1
```
eli: prefix_hash same, checksum differs -> tokenization mismatch likely. this inflates confirmed vs provisional on per-route charts.
maya: plausible. quantized vs fp variants sometimes use slightly different tokenizer settings. resume re-tokenizes on the new model.
derek: short-term: ledger can store session+prefix -> checksum TTL=60s and treat a later confirmed with different checksum as a "tokenization-rewrite" event, reconciling instead of double-billing. emit metric tokenization_rewrite_detected.
sara: and console should surface these as a distinct event type and collapse them by default in the provisional/confirmed diff UI. add a resume_tokenizer_mismatch metric on router too.
maya: runtime can include checksum with provisional credit and echo it on resume RPC when available. small patch.
derek: gate ledger change behind feature-flag; canary for 2h then expand. alert if >5 rewrites/min for org.
ops-bot: Deploy plan created: ledger-flag -> canary -> 2h monitor -> stage rollout
sara: i'll open dashboard ticket for collapse + event band.
maya: i'll open PRs for runtime checksum emit and add metric.
derek: i'll own rollout + monitoring.
eli: thanks all, i'll notify support if customer-facing spikes appear.
